body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared 100-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains 1.21×, 1.46×, and 2.30× faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, 43.2% (4B) and 49.0% (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.
summaryZh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过检查任务结果来训练语言模型，但将终端奖励分配给单个推理token或动作依然具有挑战性。群组相对方法（如GRPO）虽对每个提示采样多次尝试，但在所有尝试获得相同时会丢失学习信号。本文提出了后见特权RLVR（HP-RLVR），这是一种单 rollout 方法，它将已完成轨迹自身的未来转化为token级别的更新权重。该方法通过因果历史和包含未来与验证器反馈的后见上下文对每个候选token进行评分，利用归一化的Jensen-Shannon散度来加权奖励，从而为成功和失败的尝试提供有界的token信用。在Qwen3-8B上的实验表明，HP-RLVR比GRPO训练速度更快，且无需学习评论家模型。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出单 rollout 的 HP-RLVR 算法，无需群组采样即可在可验证奖励强化学习中为单个 reasoning token 分配信用。

glossary.explanationZh: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards，基于可验证结果的强化学习方法。
Group Relative Policy Optimization，一种通过多轨迹相对比较进行策略优化的强化学习算法。
将任务最终结果的奖励精确分配给生成序列中各个token的技术或信用分配机制。
一种衡量两个概率分布之间相似性的数学指标。
